title: Model merge-chain override layers
description: data-pack/models/overrides.json — the hand-maintained layers that sit UNDER the generated dataset in the context-limit and pricing merge chains, plus three small model lists (RM-38 WP 2.2). MERGE PRECEDENCE IS CONTRACT: legacy -> roster-gap -> generated dataset, with the DB-backed PricingRepository resolver winning over all of it. D-DP3: these values also have a COMPILED FLOOR (rendered into packages/shared/src/pack-defaults.generated.ts by `pnpm build:data-pack`), because an unknown context window silently disables a guardrail and an unpriced model makes isModelPriced() false, which REFUSES a cost-capped run. The floor is a merge BASE, not an if-the-pack-is-absent fallback.

legacy_context_limits.description: Previous-generation model ids the dataset does not cover. Merged FIRST (lowest precedence).

roster_gap_context_limits.description: Current-generation ids the live provider rosters offer but the dataset snapshot predates. Merged SECOND. A missing entry resolves to 0, which disables compaction and makes every '% of context used' surface meaningless.

legacy_pricing.description: The pricing twin of legacy_context_limits. Merged FIRST. The zero_price_models entries are spread in by pricing.ts and are NOT repeated here.

roster_gap_pricing.description: The pricing twin of roster_gap_context_limits. Merged SECOND. List prices per 1M tokens; time-varying prices belong in the DB-backed resolver, which carries effective dates.

zero_price_models.description: EXPLICIT zero-price allowlist — local/Ollama models with no per-token list price. Priced at an explicit 0 AND treated as a KNOWN price, which is what distinguishes 'genuinely free' from 'we have no price at all'.

model_id_aliases.description: Run-engine model id -> dataset model id. Deliberately small: it captures genuine aliases and snapshot-pinned ids only.

default_heatmap_models.description: The default compatibility-heatmap column set when the caller passes no explicit model list.

assistant_default_model_roster.description: The honest fallback for the Claude subscription's live model list, used on any error/timeout/not-signed-in. Env-overridable via ASSISTANT_MODEL_ROSTER.

assistant_default_title_model.description: The cheap model the thread-title one-shot runs on. Env-overridable via ASSISTANT_TITLE_MODEL.
